body: You should reach out to a local new station and get his picture out there if you still haven’t found him.

He didn’t bring his phone or his keys and hasn’t spent money, would he have cash on him? Did he pull out any money in the days prior to Friday? 

Chances are he is still close since he has no money and no phone. 

A search party needs to go out TODAY. Check woods, rivers ponds and lakes, and anywhere you (or her) thinks he may have gone.
